note: Level 1 speech-suite fixture set (Phase 6 TASK 6.3a). Reference transcripts are the exact text each clip was synthesized from (scripts/generate_audio_fixtures.py and the Phase 6 additions). All clips are Piper TTS, not recorded human speech; 'accented' means the British English Piper voice.

items.reference: The deployment finished about ten minutes ago, and it looks good.
I checked the logs first, and found the issue quickly.
I'd say the whole process took roughly three weeks, give or take a few days.
I disagreed with my manager about the deadline, so I brought data to the meeting and we agreed on a smaller scope.
We sharded the Postgres cluster, put Redis in front of it, and moved the Kubernetes ingress behind a load balancer.
The p95 latency regressed after the gRPC migration, so we rolled back the canary and added an index.
